name: knowledge-tool
description: A Codex learning workflow plugin that creates external, resumable study folders for topics and code projects.

interface.shortDescription: Interview, plan, test, and resume learning any topic or code project.
interface.longDescription: KnowledgeTool guides Codex through a structured learning loop: learner interview, multi-perspective research, conflict mapping, resource triage, staged practice, retrieval testing, Feynman review, and one-page cheat sheets. User study content is always written outside the plugin source into configurable learning directories.
